args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity):
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
Fixed in 2.9.4. Staying on the 2.x line to avoid a major-version
upgrade to 3.x.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

## Details
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`
- Per the advisory, affected range is `<2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed versions are `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`. Chose `2.9.4` to stay on the 2.x line and avoid a breaking major-version upgrade.
- `requests` dependency unchanged.
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
